_comment: Example output from MeetingPrepAgent — investor brief for one-on-one

investorSummaries.name: Portfolio Manager — Brazil Equities
investorSummaries.estimatedPosition: ~1.8% of free float (custody estimate, as of 1Q26)
openConcerns: Working capital cycle lengthening in H2 2025

keyMessagingPoints: [SOURCE: msg-2026-001] Capital allocation framework: 50% of FCF to dividends, 30% to organic growth capex, 20% optionality for M&A.
[SOURCE: msg-2026-002] EBITDA margin improvement driven by operational leverage and cost efficiency program initiated in 2H25.
[SOURCE: msg-2026-003] Leverage target: Net Debt/EBITDA below 2.0x through the cycle.

anticipatedQuestions.question: What is your leverage ceiling for M&A?
anticipatedQuestions.suggestedAnswer: [SOURCE: qa-2026-042] We are comfortable operating up to 2.5x Net Debt/EBITDA for the right strategic acquisition, with a clear deleveraging path to below 2.0x within 18-24 months.

anticipatedQuestions.question: Are you considering any guidance revision for 2026?
anticipatedQuestions.doNotAnswerReason: Guidance revision is PROHIBITED from discussion until formally approved. Respond: 'We are not in a position to comment on guidance outside of our formal earnings communications. We will update guidance at our Q1 2026 results call.'

doNotDiscuss: Any guidance revision or update (not yet approved)
meetingBrief.backgroundContext: BlackRock has been a top-10 shareholder since 2023. Last meeting covered capital allocation and ESG disclosure. Tone was constructive. PM raised concerns about working capital cycle in Q4 2025 — these should be addressed with Q4 2025 results data.
meetingBrief.lastInteractionSummary: November 2025 roadshow meeting in New York. PM satisfied with strategic narrative but flagged concern about accounts receivable days. Committed to follow up with CFO explanation — verify this was followed up.
meetingBrief.perceptionRisk: LOW — long-term holder, constructive on strategy. Main risk: if leverage increases above 2.5x without clear strategic rationale.

preparationChecklist.item: Trading window confirmed open on meeting date
Q4 2025 results publicly available before meeting
Latest approved messaging confirmed with Head of IR
Reg FD reminder briefed to all meeting attendees
Working capital follow-up from Nov 2025 meeting confirmed completed
